pairs.subject: voice-io

pairs.registryProposal: The boundary paragraph excludes 'producing ... to a creative brief', but render-acceptance, authored-voice-identity and real-time-synthesis-budget ('belongs in the content pipeline') reach into pre-rendered voiceover. State explicitly whether a voiceover content pipeline is in voice-io scope for those three techniques, or hand them to generated-speech-acceptance. Without that, seats will split on contexts like this one.
